subject: Drafting evidence delegation & signer matrix for marketplace addendum
messages:
From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@cloudmall.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@cloudmall.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 12:05:00 -0500
Subject: Marketplace addendum — evidence and signer responsibilities

Hi Naomi / Redwood team,

Thanks for the redlines you sent yesterday. Our legal team reviewed page 4 (pass-through clause) and flagged two operational asks before procurement will sign: (1) who will be the primary point for evidence requests (audit logs, invoice trail) and (2) how long CloudMall should retain evidence for marketplace-related resales.

Can you confirm: is the evidence retention tied to the Order Form or the MSA? Also — can you provide a simple matrix of who signs or responds to requests in the partner flow (Redwood ops, Redwood legal, reseller ops at CloudMall)? Procurement would like this mapped out in the addendum before routing to finance.

Sanjay
Sanjay Patel
Head of Strategic Partnerships | CloudMall
Sanjay.Patel@cloudmall.com
Tel: +1 415-555-0192

---
Attaching for reference: CloudMall's standard partner evidence template (see link they provided in their portal).

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@cloudmall.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace addendum — evidence and signer responsibilities

Hi Sanjay — thanks for the quick review. Good questions; I pulled the team in and sketched a proposed approach below so Procurement can confirm.

Summary proposal (high level):
- Evidence retention: tie to the Order Form term for the reseller relationship (so retention == contract term + 1 year), with a default fallback to MSA for platform-level logs.
- Primary responder: Redwood Ops will be the operational owner for evidence requests (audit logs, token usage slices, invoice trace), with Redwood Legal as escalation for any contractual disputes or subpoenas.
- Signer matrix: Redwood will sign the addendum (Authorized Signatory from Legal) and designate an Ops contact for request fulfillment. CloudMall should provide the reseller contact who will be responsible for forwarding customer requests to Redwood.

Next steps I propose: I attached a short checklist mapping the items you asked for and a signer delegation table. Ben and Karthik — can you review the attached draft addendum and the checklist and flag any legal/ops gaps? Laura — can you confirm the expected retention windows from an operations standpoint?

Thanks,
Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Senior Partner Manager | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: marketplace-addendum-draft_v3.docx (draft addendum), pass-through-evidence-checklist.xlsx (delegation/signer table)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@cloudmall.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 10:42:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace addendum — evidence and signer responsibilities

Folks — quick legal review notes after a pass on v3: 
- Happy with retention being ordered by Order Form term + 1 year, but insert explicit language that operational logs (non-PII usage metrics) may be retained for longer for security/diagnostic purposes — specify "up to 3 years" and call out the categories.
- For evidence requests, we should define a SLA: Redwood will acknowlege requests within 3 business days and provide an initial data scope within 10 business days. That helps CloudMall procurement assess response timelines.
- Signer: legal will sign the addendum but ops contact must be included in Annex A (request routing) with email and escalation phone.

Ben
Ben Carter
Sr. Contracts Counsel | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwoodinference.com

---
On the redline itself I inserted a narrow pass-through clause that keeps liability allocation limited to invoiced passthroughs and excludes non-billed logs. See comment markers in marketplace-addendum-draft_v3.docx.

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@cloudmall.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 08:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace addendum — evidence and signer responsibilities

Adding an infra/serving note: when CloudMall asks for "audit logs" we need to be explicit about scope — are they asking for customer-level request logs (which we can provide as tokenized usage slices) or raw server logs that include infrastructure metadata? If the latter, we need a narrower carve-out and security review.

Operational suggestion: create a short form Evidence Request Form that CloudMall can use; this will standardize requests and prevent legal scope creep. I've updated pass-through-evidence-checklist.xlsx with a proposed evidence request template and column for "data sensitivity".

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Platform Security | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com

From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@cloudmall.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@cloudmall.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Marketplace addendum — evidence and signer responsibilities

Thanks everyone — that map helps. Procurement is OK with: Order Form term + 1 year retention, Redwood SLA for evidence (acknowledge 3 business days / scope in 10 business days), and a short Evidence Request Form. Two asks from procurement before routing to finance: (1) can Redwood commit to including the Annex A ops contact in the executed DocuSign packet, and (2) will Redwood accept a standard "reasonably requested" clause in the pass-through that references the Evidence Request Form?

We'd like to close this week. I've started the DocuSign envelope; link below. Could Naomi or Ben confirm who will be the executing signatory and whether we should expect any further redlines?

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/recipient/1234567890

Sanjay

---
Procurement note: target internal routing for finance approval by Fri 27 Nov.

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@cloudmall.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 17:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace addendum — evidence and signer responsibilities

Sanjay — thanks. Ben will be the legal executing signatory for the addendum; Operations contact that will be included in Annex A is Laura Bennett (laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, +1 650-555-0123).

We can accept the "reasonably requested" phrasing as long as requests must be submitted via the Evidence Request Form and are limited to the categories in Annex B (usage slices, invoice trail, and account-level audit logs). We'll countersign in DocuSign after a final quick pass from Ben on the platform carve-outs Karthik mentioned. Expect Ben's sign-off by end of day tomorrow.

Naomi
